ESD Protection Placement

The file /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb has 4 external connectors (J1-J4) each protected by an ESD array (D1-D4). The ESD arrays are currently placed far from their connectors. The file /home/user/Desktop/esd_map.csv maps each connector pad to its ESD signal pad and net.

Move each ESD array so its signal pin (as listed in /home/user/Desktop/esd_map.csv column esd_signal_pad) is within 5 mm of the corresponding connector pad. Do not change connector positions. Preserve the ESD footprint rotation.

Requirements:
1. Each ESD signal pad is <= 5 mm from its connector pad (per /home/user/Desktop/esd_map.csv).
2. Connector footprint positions unchanged.
3. ESD footprint rotation preserved.

Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb.
source: TI / Analog Devices / Nordic / Microchip PCB layout app notes (TESD5V5U4LC TDK app note), IPC-A-610H Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies
